lm.caption: An energetic and driving Russian rock track kicks off with a full-band assault. Two crunchy, distorted electric guitars lay down a foundation of powerful chord progressions and melodic lead lines, propelled by a punchy, straightforward acoustic drum beat and a solid bass guitar. A passionate male lead vocal, delivered with a slight rasp and high energy, soars over the mix. The chorus intensifies with layered backing vocals adding depth and power to the main vocal line.
